interactive.label: Open TTTR / imaging
interactive.tooltip: Load photon data or follow an imaging HDF5 source reference.

interactive.label: MMFDB dataset
interactive.tooltip: Resolve registered photon data to a local input file.

interactive.label: Build CLSM
interactive.tooltip: Reconstruct and fill a scanner image using the acquisition settings.

interactive.label: Add representation
interactive.tooltip: Compute the selected intensity or micro-time representation.

interactive.label: Compute decay
interactive.tooltip: Compute the photon histogram of selected pixels.

interactive.label: Add decay → ChiSurf
interactive.tooltip: Publish the current decay as a real ChiSurf experimental dataset.

interactive.label: Export image
interactive.tooltip: Save the current physical image as a TIFF.

interactive.label: Export decay CSV
interactive.tooltip: Export time, counts and Poisson noise of the current decay.

interactive.label: Setup preset
interactive.tooltip: Restore scanner markers, file type and reading routine from a named acquisition preset.

interactive.label: channels_text
interactive.tooltip: Comma-separated photon routing channels.

interactive.label: Acquisition
interactive.tooltip: Expand or collapse Acquisition.

interactive.label: Brush & Decay
interactive.tooltip: Expand or collapse Brush & Decay.

interactive.label: size
interactive.tooltip: Edge length of the brush in pixels (1 to 99).

interactive.label: width
interactive.tooltip: Width (sigma) of the brush kernel in pixels; a smaller value gives a harder edge.

interactive.label: select
interactive.tooltip: Paint pixels into the selection with the left mouse button.

interactive.label: deselect
interactive.tooltip: Erase pixels from the selection with the left mouse button.

interactive.label: Live update
interactive.tooltip: Recompute the decay while brushing.

interactive.label: n_ph_min
interactive.tooltip: Minimum photons per pixel for the mean micro time.

interactive.label: frame_idx
interactive.tooltip: The frame used when Frames is set to frame.

interactive.label: Use pixel markers
interactive.tooltip: Use explicit per-pixel marker records instead of time-derived raster positions.

interactive.label: marker_pixel
interactive.tooltip: Routing marker code for the beginning of a pixel.

interactive.label: n_lines
interactive.tooltip: Explicit scanner line count; zero uses pixels/line.

interactive.label: Paint selection
interactive.tooltip: Reserve left-mouse dragging for selecting/erasing pixels; use the middle button to pan.

interactive.label: Clear selection
interactive.tooltip: Clear painted pixels and the active decay.

interactive.label: Save painted region
interactive.tooltip: Capture painted pixels as a reusable named mask region.

interactive.label: roi_name
interactive.tooltip: Name for the saved painted mask.

interactive.label: Analysis regions
interactive.tooltip: Restrict detection to named regions; empty or disabled regions use the entire frame.

interactive.label: Save settings
interactive.tooltip: Persist acquisition, brush and representation settings plus region geometry.

interactive.label: Load settings
interactive.tooltip: Restore acquisition, brush and representation settings plus region geometry.
